svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Ingredient crates (28)
svg.desc: Four per ingredient: three to stock an island at 3–4 players, one spare for the black market. Wheat, milk, sugar, eggs, cocoa, cinnamon, vanilla — the app's own icons, redrawn as cuttable outlines. Units: mm. 25 mm squares, 6 mm material. No kerf compensation in this file — it is a design view; cut from the sheet-N files. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
